It also engages in the manufacture industrialization and sale of wood-based furniture; ownership and management of equity interests; management of logistics operations; and provision of integrated solutions for e-commerce and multi-marketplace operations such as fulfillment transportation and full commerce (white label) services through technology platforms and plug and play operating models as well as management of digital solutions. In addition the company offers financial services through its mobile app including the digital management of the Casas Bahia installment payment plan payments transfers mobile recharges and other financial services. Further it is involved in the management and operation of payment instruments comprising prepaid cards and other payment arrangements; granting of credit through an electronic platform financing and the acquisition of credit rights; and the development management and licensing of technological solutions digital platforms and systems. Additionally the company provides services including intermediation in the sale of extended warranty equipment installation marketplace and financial and operational services such as installment sales and co-branded credit cards. It serves consumers through brick and-mortar stores and e-commerce platforms under Casas Bahia Ponto and Extra.com brands. The company was formerly known as Via S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. in September 2023. Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E)
Description: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and cement products. The company also produces packing bags. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) is a subsidiary of Vicat Cement Egypt.

Name: Iochpe-Maxion S.A.
Description: Iochpe-Maxion S.A. together with its subsidiaries produces and sells automotive wheels and structural components in Brazil North America South America Europe the Middle East Africa Asia and internationally. The company offers aluminum wheels steel wheels and structural components for commercial and light vehicles. It also provides side rails and chassis for commercial vehicles; stamped parts for light vehicles; and railway equipment. Iochpe-Maxion S.A. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Cruzeiro Brazil.

Name: Alamar Foods Company
Description: Alamar Foods Company together with its subsidiaries establishes operates and manages quick service restaurants in the Middle East North Africa and Pakistan. It operates restaurants under the Domino’s and Dunkin’ brands under franchisee agreements. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Alamar Foods Company is a subsidiary of Abdul Aziz Ibrahim Al Jammaz and Brothers Company.

Name: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E)
Description: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells carpets in Egypt and internationally. It offers machine-woven tufted needle-punched and jet-printed rugs mats Gobelin tapestries upholstery floor covers and Axminster carpets. The company serves hotels luxury residential and commercial markets. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd.
Description: Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacturing packaging wholesale and retail trade of food products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Arab Republic of Egypt and internationally. It offers halawa maamoul tahina breaded chicken meat dairy cheese jams juices and olives and red pepper with oil. The company also provides sterile swabs; tissue boxes; tissue sachets; and brown and white sugar sachets etc. Additionally it offers catering services. The company was founded in 1830 and is headquartered in Jeddah the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Halwani Bros. Co. Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Aseer Al-Arabia for Industrial Investment.

Name: Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company
Description: Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading wholesale and maintenance of spare parts electronic equipment household equipment and air-conditioners in Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Heating Ventilation and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) Solutions; Home Appliances; and All Other. It provides residential and commercial air conditioners including chillers and related services; televisions washing machines dryers refrigerators irons gas cookers and floor care; and consultancy services for energy solutions. The company also engages in sale of mobile phones; importing exporting and marketing services; wholesale of electronic devices and household appliances; financial and insurance activities; constructions transportation and storage activities as well as offers agency services. It provides its products under the LG Indesit Ariston Maytag and Bompani Samsung Black and Decker and Midea brands. Al Hassan Ghazi Ibrahim Shaker Company was founded in 1950 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the design manufacture and sale of textile products in Turkey and internationally. It offers dresses sweatshirts t-shirts pants skirts shirts blouses crops knitwear cardigans tank tops shorts vests jackets leggings jeans outerwear joggers trousers sweatshirts swimsuits sweatbottoms sweaters underwear boxers swim trunks jumpsuits salopet and beanie products bikini sets coats and cargo products; partywear sportswear and lingerie and loungewear products; and accessories including bags perfumes hats shawls jewelry and straw products necklaces earrings bracelets rings belts pet clothes purses socks and pantyhose products and hair accessories for women men kids and infants. The coompany also provides license products. It sells its products through wholesale or in retail through its stores such as franchise department corner and other individual stores operated by franchise holders; and online. Koton Magazacilik Tekstil Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S.
Description: Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. manufactures and sells vehicle tires and related products in North America South America Europe the Middle East Africa and Asia. It is involved in the manufacturing of industrial cloth products transmission belts V-belts rubber hoses and rubber and plastic products; industrial single cord with industrial fabrics in the structure of the material; and heavy denier fiber and connection fabrics; as well as the processing and marketing of guide cloth products and other rubber reinforcement materials. The company also provides rubber cords and mechanical rubber good fabrics. In addition it offers advanced composites to the civil aviation sector; and nylon 6 nylon 6.6 and polyethylene terephthalate high modulus low shrinkage polyester as well as rayon heavy decitex yarns for use in tires and mechanical rubber goods. Further the company offers composites technologies comprising polymeric matrix prepregs ceramic matrix prepregs slittape and towpreg products films honeycombs and other products. The company was formerly known as Kordsa Endüstriyel Iplik ve Kord Bezi Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. in March 2017. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Izmit Turkey. Kordsa Teknik Tekstil A.S. is a subsidiary of Haci Ömer Sabanci Holding A.S.

Name: Hitit Bilgisayar Hizmetleri A.S.
Description: Hitit Bilgisayar Hizmetleri A.S. develops and sells airline and travel technology solutions under the Crane brand in Turkey and internationally. The company offers passenger service system (PSS) a suite of solutions comprising reservation and passenger services internet booking engine reservations and passenger service mobile application allotment manager departure control system weight and balance baggage reconciliation itinerary and loyalty layer; operations planning solutions consisting of crew tracking schedule and capacity planning strategic planning and operations control; and accounting solutions such as revenue accounting cost accounting and business performance index. It also provides Crane TM a travel marketplace platform that enables airlines to set up a travel marketplace for its tour operator and online travel agency (OTA) partners to create and sell leisure and business travel packages; travel solutions including Crane OTA multilingual and multi-currency online travel platform and Crane APP an agent portal for airlines; and cargo solutions such as reservation and cargo services and domestic cargo services. In addition the company offers technical infrastructure and hosting consultancy and training and after-sales support and maintenance services. It serves airlines travel companies and airports. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Kontrolmatik Teknoloji Enerji Ve Muhendislik Anonim Sirketi an engineering company provides system integration services and technological products and solutions. The company operates through the Energy Mining and Robotics Technology segments. It serves power generation transmission and distribution facilities oil and natural gas transportation food and beverage mining agriculture and fertilizer power plant subsidiaries operational technologies industrial software control and security systems communication data processing internet of things power systems and turnkey solution sectors as well as other industrial facilities such as cement paper iron-steel and chemistry. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical ampoules in Egypt and internationally. The company provides analgesics and antipyretic; analgesics and anti-inflammatory; anti-infective; antihistamine; cardiovascular and metabolics; corticosteroids; gastrointestinal tract; nervous system; ophthalmic; respiratory; topical ointment and cream; vitamins; and miscellaneous products. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: GOIL Plc
Description: GOIL Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the marketing of petroleum and other energy products and services in Ghana. It offers jet fuels fuels liquefied petroleum gas auto LP gas lubricants bitumen polymer aviation fuel and specialty products; bunkering services; marine gas oil; distributes various petroleum products including gasoline kerosene diesel marine and mining diesel and lubricants and premix fuel; and provides fuel cards. In addition the company offers electronic payments money transfers and other IT-related business; consultancy; and other support services. It operates through retail network of service stations and consumer outlets as well as lube bays. The company was formerly known as Ghana Oil Company. GOIL Plc was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Accra Ghana.

Name: Sonda S.A.
Description: Sonda S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides information technology (IT) solutions in the United States Canada Chile Brazil Argentina Colombia Ecuador Guatemala Panama Uruguay Costa Rica Mexico and Peru. It operates through Digital Business Digital Services and Transactional Business segments. The company offers digital software factory digital architecture and data and advance analytics as well as network and edge DaaS and IaaS cloud and datacenter cybersecurity workplace services and technology infrastructure and services. It also provides high availability IT and OT networks collaborative hybrid work network transformation service and comprehensive communications outsourcing. In addition the company offers ERP FIN700 SAP and Autodesk; and sales of computing infrastructure including servers workstations tablets PCs printers storage and backup equipment communications equipment databases operating systems and others. Sonda S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Kepler Weber S.A.
Description: Kepler Weber S.A. provides grain storage equipment and post-harvest grain solutions in Brazil the Americas Africa Europe and Asia. It operates through five segments: Farms Agroindustry Ports and Terminals Replacement and Services and International Business. The company offers grain storage and preservation systems such as silos dryers and conveyors and cleaning machines. It also provides equipment for agricultural commodities such as corn ethanol soybean oil animal feed wheat mills rice industries cooperative complexes cereal producers and seedbeds; industrial equipment; and port terminals. In addition the company offers spare parts and technical assistance services; technical engineering and data processing services; engineering risk insurance services; and grain temperature and moisture monitoring services in the processing and storage process. Additionally it imports and exports raw materials and finished and semifinished goods. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E
Description: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers clinker and Portland pozzolana cement products. It also provides delivery and export services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi
Description: Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi retails mother and baby products in Turkey and internationally. It sells its products through retail and e-commerce channels. Ebebek Magazacilik Anonim Sirketi was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Herfy Food Services Company
Description: Herfy Food Services Company establishes and operates restaurants in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through Restaurants Meat Factory and Bakeries. It operates restaurants under the HERFY name. The company also produces and sells frozen products bakery and pastry products through bakeries and bakery shops under the Herfy Bakeries/Dokka name; and meat products. In addition it provides cooked meals; catering services; purchases and sells land for constructing buildings; and owns uses maintains and leases warehouses and food store fridges. Herfy Food Services Company was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Najran Cement Company
Description: Najran Cement Company engages in the manufacture and sale of cement products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers ordinary Portland Portland pozzolanic cement plastering cement and Portland sulfate-resistant cement products. It also engages in the transportation of goods. Najran Cement Company was founded in 2005 and is based in Najran the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao
Description: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao operates supermarkets specialized stores in Brazil. The company sells food products beverages fruits vegetables meat bread cold cuts and dairy products. It also engages in retail of food and other products under Pão de Açúcar Minuto Pão de Açúcar Extra Mercado and Minimercado Extra brand names. It also offers baby items cleaning products pet care and more under its private label and third-party brands. In addition the company sells its products through its physical stores websites or apps. Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A.
Description: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides tourism services in Brazil and internationally. The company offers services in the areas of accommodation entertainment land and air transportation cruises seafarers cultural and professional exchange and others. It operates under Almundo.com Biblos CVC and Ola brands. CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Grupo Multi S.A.
Description: Grupo Multi S.A. engages in the development manufacture distributes and sells electronic products in Brazil. It provides blenders fryers pans ovens mixer coffee makers kettles sandwich makers food warmer scales omelette maker hood food processors parts and accessories for mixers. It also offers vacuum cleaners circulators heaters fans iron vaporizer drinking fountain popcorn maker wineries and ice machines; and electric toothbrush refill oral irrigator compressor inhaler mesh inhaler air humidifier aroma diffuser oximeter medication spacer essential oils scented candles electric toothbrush irrigator nozzles and accessories. Further the company offers digital thermometer infrared thermometer baby thermometer arm blood pressure monitor wrist blood pressure monitor blood glucose monitor lancet blood glucose strips electric racket and electric insect killer; digital scales bioimpedance scales gel and thermal bags knee brace elastic knee pad and elbow pad wristband elastic thigh and ankle strap. Additionally It provides smartphones cell phones tablets computers and notebooks security UPS batteries and accessories; access control automation lighting and security monitoring related products; steering wheel monitor cabinet webcam controls headset keyboard mouse mouse pad microphone VR glasses cables memories and SSD and sound box; and printing supplies sticky-notes-pad staplers punchers organizers digitizing tablets electronic waste bins glues and books and office supplies. The company offers household utensils hardware tools sports automotive beauty and skin care products as well as provides toys for pets and infants and health care products. It provides audio video screen and projectors. Grupo Multi S.A. was formerly known as Multilaser Industrial S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Multi S.A. in April 2024. Grupo Multi S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A.
Description: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. provides internet services in Brazil. The company offers fiber optic internet telecommunication and mobile telephony services. Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. was founded in 1998 and is based in Pereiro Brazil. Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Brisanet Participações S.A.

Name: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A.
Description: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. captures produces bottles and markets still and carbonated natural mineral waters in Morocco. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of preforms as well as bottling and marketing of table water. The company offers its products under the Sidi Ali Oulmès Aïn Atlas Vitalya Bahia Purifya Glass' Orangina Fifa of Sainte Luce and DIAM brands. Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: A'Saffa Foods SAOG
Description: A'Saffa Foods SAOG manufactures and distributes poultry meat in Oman. It offers fresh frozen and processed chicken products; and vegetables and fruit products. The company was formerly known as ASaffa Poultry Farms SAOG and changed its name to A'Saffa Foods SAOG in April 2010. A'Saffa Foods SAOG was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ruwi Oman.

Name: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG
Description: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel products in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company offers black and galvanized pipes hollow sections merchant bar mill products and rebars. It also operates tube mill and merchant bar mill facilities. Its products are used in construction scaffolding irrigation agriculture engineering public health fencing steam and gas facilities firefighting and water and sanitation pipes. The company was formerly known as Al Jazeera Tube Mills Company S.A.O.G. Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of white goods in Turkey. The company produces and sells refrigerators room air conditioning units washing machines cookers dryers dishwashers and water heaters. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Vestel Beyaz Esya Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.

Name: Nampak Limited
Description: Nampak Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of packaging products in South Africa and rest of Africa. The company offers beverage food and aerosol cans; and other metal packaging products. It also provides date/batch small character ink jet and large character ink jet coding; laser coding technologies; thermal transfer overprinting; thermal inkjet printing; marking addressing barcoding and labelling solutions; metal detection; X-ray inspection; package integrity inspection/pressure or vacuum loss detection; and fume extraction systems. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company
Description: Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company engages in the retail of apparel and fashion products. The company offers lingerie nightwear and ready-to-wear under the Nayomi Mihyar and Dream brand names. It operates through retail stores and online. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Jeddah Saudi Arabia. Jamjoom Fashion Trading Company operates as a subsidiary of Kamal Osman Jamjoom Trading LLC (KSA).

Name: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO
Description: Saudi Company for Hardware SACO engages in the retail and wholesale of household and office supplies and appliances construction tools and equipment and electrical tools and hardware in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through two segments: Sales and Services and Logistic Services. The company offers freight forwarding transportation and contract logistics as well as delivery installation and maintenance services. It also provides port handling trans-shipment warehouse management and maintenance custom clearance services transportation of goods and others. It sells its products online. Saudi Company for Hardware SACO was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Biotrend Cevre ve Enerji Yatirimlari A.S.
Description: Biotrend Cevre ve Enerji Yatirimlari A.S. engages in integrated waste management-oriented renewable energy circular raw materials and fuel production activities in Turkey. It is involved in the waste disposal; mechanical sorting; recycled products; refuse-derived fuel; generation of electricity and heat from biogas landfill gas and biomass; carbon trading; composting; sanitary landfills; and greenhouse farming. The company also engages in production of energy using fermentation  incineration technologies; operation of solid waste storage areas mechanical separation plant waste derived fuel preparation plant leachate treatment plant biological treatment plant and landfill gas; and installation and operation of power generation plants as well as provision of engineering contracting and consulting services. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Biotrend Cevre ve Enerji Yatirimlari A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Doganlar Investment Holding A.S.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A.
Description: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A. operates as a real estate developer and builder in Brazil. The company develops and sells residential projects hotels and art centers. It is also involved in land prospecting; real estate development and sale; broker portal operation; and project construction activities. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the production and sale of polyurethane system in Turkey. It offers polyurethane raw material for unit sole slipper system safety shoe sole polyurethane boot insole polyester polyol and polymeric polyester polyol systems as well as release agents and liquid color master batch systems. The company also provides polyurethane raw material  for sandwich pipe insulation spray foam polyurea systems polyurethane rubber binder system and shutter and sectional doors polyurethane systems; elastomers; release agents; polyester polyols; integral foam filter foam and sound insulation systems; and office furniture foam wood imitation viscoelastic integral foam polyester polyol systems for flame laminations. In addition it offers commercial and domestic refrigerator systems cold storage room refrigerator container systems and boiler and solar panel systems; EVA compounds thermoplastic polyurethane polyurethane gels and stress ball systems; and polyols for rigid polyurethane and foam and CASE Applications. Kimteks Poliüretan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme
Description: Tunisie Profilés Aluminium Société Anonyme engages in the design manufacture and sale of aluminum alloy profiles for building and industrial needs in Tunisia. The company also offers swing carpentry sliding carpentry facades and sun breezes armored carpentry inner wall bodyguard roller shutter and other products.  It exports its products. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Taaleem Management Services Company offers private higher education and skills-based learning services in Egypt. It operates Nahda University Badya University and Memphis University. The company was formerly known as Bisco Investment Company and changed its name to Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E. in July 2016. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Trisul S.A.
Description: Trisul S.A. engages in the construction and development of real estate properties in Brazil. The company is involved in the subdivision of plots of land; and purchase and sale of properties. It also develops real estate projects with ownership interest of third parties. Trisul S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. through its subsidiaries engages in the design manufacture sale and marketing of auto parts and housewares in Mexico Europe Asia Spain the Czech Republic Poland Italy and China. It operates through Auto Parts and Home segments. The company offers gray and ductile iron and aluminum components for automotive systems including brakes engines and chassis. It also provides kitchen and tableware items such as vitrified steel and aluminum as well as ceramic tableware for domestic and institutional use. The company sells its products under the Draxton and Cinsa brands. Grupo Industrial Saltillo S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 1928 and is based in Saltillo Mexico.

Name: Carthage Cement SA
Description: Carthage Cement SA manufactures markets and sells hydraulic binders in Tunisia. The company offers Portland cement Portland high sulfate resistance cement clinker and artificial hydraulic lime. It is also involved in the exploitation production and marketing of aggregates including gravel run material ballast and cement blocks source rock and sharp sand; and production and marketing of ready-mixed concrete. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Balady Poultry Company
Description: Balady Poultry Company together with its subsidiaries produces poultry products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers whole and marinated chicken; and chicken parts including gizzards hearts breasts thighs whole chicken feet wings mix chicken pieces liver feet and legs as well as chicken fillet. It also engages in the rearing and production of laying boiler breeders and operation of its hatcheries; operation of slaughterhouses for the slaughter and preparation of poultry rabbit and bird meat; land transportation of refrigerated and frozen goods; sales agents in pharmaceuticals wholesale of feed and non-pharmaceutical feed additives; and production of chilled and frozen meat poultry rabbits and birds as well as poultry feed. In addition the company is involved in the production of fertilizers from organic materials and potassium fertilizers; construction and renovation of residential and non-residential buildings such as schools hospitals and hotels; and construction of government buildings. The company was formerly known as Balady Poultry Trading Company. Balady Poultry Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Khamis Mushait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG
Description: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in engineering contracting and construction businesses in the Sultanate of Oman and Abu Dhabi. It operates through four segments: Construction Manufacturing Hiring of Equipment and Training of Personnel. The company constructs a range of projects including palaces commercial establishments housing complexes educational institutions hospitals monuments religious structures stadiums showrooms telephone exchanges and residences. It also provides design civil mechanical electrical and instrumentation services for oil and gas pipelines and flow lines; construction of oil storage tanks gathering stations enhance oil recovery projects and compressor stations; and design and construction of power transmission systems. In addition the company constructs railways roads bridges dams seaports airports and water and wastewater transmissions; and provides operation and maintenance of water transmission networks infrastructure works of industrial parks and refineries and large- scale earthmoving projects. Further it is involved in hiring equipment; training services; engineering procurement and construction consultancy services; public health engineering; production and sale of ready-mix concrete products; electrical and HVAC services; and plumbing and maintenance contracts. Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A.
Description: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. provides industrial infrastructure integrity engineering and inspection services in the petrochemical pulp and paper steel offshore naval mining and infrastructure sectors in Brazil. The company provides access solutions including design planning assembly and rental of access equipment tube and clamp and modular scaffolding systems  suspended scaffolding and the web prinerdeck platforms tension netting system and rope access; mechanical and manual surface treatment abrasive and wet blasting ultra-high-pressure water jetting (UHP); weather protection passive fire protection(PFP) leak sealing hot and cold thermal insulation acoustic insulation and process heating and refractory lining as well as civil maintenance boilermaking; chemical analysis metallographic analysis corrosion testing field solutions procedure and welder qualification and failure analysis anchored retaining walls soil nailing shotcrete soil treatment and load testing; pressurized habitat solutions; non-destructive testing inspection of equipment and facilities welding engineering advanced engineering materials engineering and laboratory services training and consulting inspection software and tank inspection services. It also offers conventional removable and reusable PFP hot and cold insulation and thermoplastic coating; industrial park; inspection and RBI finite element analysis and fracture mechanics. In addition the company provides CIPP Point repair Steam curing process pressurized networks and UV Line curing process; and resin injection gallery plugging structural repair and reinforcement waterproofing hydrodemolition and priner soil inspection. The company was formerly known as Mills SI Serviços Industriais S/A and changed its name to Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. in 2016. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Sport Clubs Company
Description: Sport Clubs Company owns and manages men’s and women’s fitness centers in Saudi Arabia. Its brands include Body Masters a fitness center for men providing amenities including cardio and strength areas fitness studios indoor cycling functional training zones football fields swimming pools and spa areas flexible personal training programs and martial arts areas; Body Motions a ladies’ club that provides amenities including cardio and strength areas fully equipped group exercise studios indoor cycling functional training zones swimming pools and spa areas and flexible personal training programs; and Body Experts which provides corporate wellness services and events. The company establishes manages and maintains gymnasiums; purchases land for the construction of buildings and invests in them by sale or lease as well as engages in the wholesale and retail trade in sports equipment tools and clothing. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Ibnsina Pharma
Description: Ibnsina Pharma operates as a pharmaceutical distributor in Egypt. The company offers pharmaceutical and cosmetics products to private and public-sector customers including retail chains independent pharmacies wholesalers hospitals and healthcare institutions. It also provides warehousing and logistics services for its suppliers; marketing solutions; importation and packaging services; and market research and analysis services as well as telesales and promotion services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG markets and distributes petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. The company is also involved in blending of lubricants. In addition it operates Shell service stations; Shell Select shops which offers various services and food and beverage choices; Shell Café an in-house coffee brand; Shell car wash for automotive cleaning services; and Shell GO+ for digital promotions. Further the company offers Shell fuel cards; industrial lubricants such as power engine oils compressor oils electrical oils greases bearings and circulating oils station gas engine oils gear oils process oils axle and transmission oils hydraulic fluids slideway oils and turbine oils. The company was formerly known as Shell Marketing (Oman) Ltd. and changed its name to Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG in June 1997. Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1958 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Cherry Trading Company
Description: Cherry Trading Company engages in the passenger car rental business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company operates through three segments: Lease Rental and Used Car Sale. It is involved in the wholesale and retail trade of new and used private cars; car services maintenance center activities; public fare; school transportation; and real estate management activities for commission. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Riyadh the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries produces and sells brown and white goods in Turkey Europe and internationally. It operates in two segments Consumer Mobility Electronics and Other Income; and Household Appliances. The company offers television headphones speakers and gaming monitors; white goods including refrigerators deep freezers washing and drying machines dishwashers freestanding ovens stovetops mini ovens microwave ovens aspirators water dispensers and wine coolers; and built-in products such as built-in sets ovens cooktops hoods microwave ovens dishwashers and refrigerators. It also provides brooms coffee machines beverage preparation mix and go mixer and chopper electric cookers vacuum machines irons personal care and retro small home appliances; air conditioners water heaters heaters and air purifiers; smart products comprising smart watch scale light plug camera bulb doorbell and tracking band as well as air purifiers; electric vehicle charging stations and Vestel mobility ecosystem; and Vestel & Asli Filinta retro series cleaning and care products spare parts and accessories product families and additional assurance and maintenance services. The company sells its products through online and its stores. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey. Vestel Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Zorlu Holding A.S.

Name: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG engages in the marketing and distribution of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through five segments: Retail Commercial Aviation Lubricants and Non-Fuel Revenue. The company offers gasoline diesel jet fuel and kerosene; retail commercial aviation and marine fuels; and lubricants including engine gear and hydraulic oils as well as specialty lubricants brake fluids engine coolants and greases under various brands such as Volvo Renault and Mack. It also provides bunkering services for vessels; Fuely a fuel delivery service; car wash services; oil and lube change services; and non-fuel related services. In addition the company offers fuel cards autofill RFID smart tags and Al Maha PLUS a smart application; and operates fuel stations convenience stores and service centers. It serves individual vehicles large road transport fleets planes and ships. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. acquires develops and operates beach and urban hotels in Mexico. It operates in three segments: Urban Services Resort Services and Operator and Holding. The company operates a portfolio of 27 hotels under the Krystal Grand Krystal Hotels & Resorts Krystal Beach and Krystal Urban brands as well as under licensed brands such as Hilton Hilton Resorts Hilton Garden Inn and Hampton Inn & Suites. It also operates third-party hotels. Grupo Hotelero Santa Fe S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Mexico City Mexico.

Name: Renaissance Services SAOG
Description: Renaissance Services SAOG together with its subsidiaries operates as an accommodation services solutions and integrated facilities management company in Oman and rest of Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services including accommodation solutions facilities management and establishment contract catering operations and maintenance training cleaning and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership building and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; investment in companies and properties as well as general trading and related activities; and integrated food service offering and laundry services. The company serves healthcare energy defense education utilities and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah Oman.

Name: Boa Safra Sementes S.A.
Description: Boa Safra Sementes S.A. produces and sells soybean seeds in Brazil. It also offers corn and bean seeds. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Formosa Brazil.

Name: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment
Description: Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment engages in manufacturing and distributing fresh and processed poultry and poultry related products under the Entaj brand. The company offers poultry table eggs live birds red meat and cold store products. It is also involved in the egg and broiler chicken production; support activities for animal production; production of chilled and frozen meat; preservation and preparation of meat and meat products in various ways such as drying and canning; production of egg products and eggshells; preparation and processing of egg products; and wholesale of dairy egg frozen meat and poultry products. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Riyadh Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment operates as a subsidiary of Arabian Agricultural Services Co. Ltd.

Name: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company
Description: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company engages in the production and sale of oil products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers fuel and transformer oils paraffin wax and derivatives gasoline and diesel neutral and special mineral oils liquefied petroleum gas naphtha and wax distillates as well as engages in the maximization of gas oil with low sulphur and pour point oil loading and blending and crude oil refining activities. It is also involved in importing exporting marketing selling and trading its products other petroleum products and supplies as well as engages in the warehouse leasing business. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Invicta Holdings Limited
Description: Invicta Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the distribution of engineering components and consumables in South Africa the Rest of Africa Europe and Asia. It operates in Replacement Parts for Industrial Equipment; Replacement Parts for Auto and Agri; Capital Equipment and Related Services; and Replacement Parts for Earthmoving Equipment. The company offers technical services including on-site installation maintenance work breakdown repair condition monitoring failure analysis design engineering and manufacturing services; engineering consumables such as bearings seals and gaskets power transmissions light and heavy materials handling fasteners geared and electric drives and motors; and fluid technology products and solutions comprising hydraulic pneumatic valves pumps filtration hose fittings and lubrication. It also supplies tools and equipment cutting welding lifting personal protective equipment locks and machine tools; imported and local vibrator motors tensioning and suspension systems; and vibrating equipment and material handling solutions. In addition the company manufactures and supplies heavy-duty belting components and imported conveyer belting to the industry. Further it supplies automotive and agricultural after-market replacement parts and kits; forklifts off-road dump trucks and related spare parts; earthmoving and materials-handling equipment; after-market replacement spare parts ground engaging tools and undercarriage parts for earthmoving equipment; aftermarket heavy-duty diesel engine parts for industrial and agricultural machinery; and heavy machinery parts and diesel engine components used for excavators bulldozers wheel loaders motor graders trucks trailers power generation sets and marine engines. Additionally it provides technical support and value-added assembly services. Invicta Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Jalles Machado S/A
Description: Jalles Machado S/A produces markets and exports sugar ethanol and other by-products from sugarcane. The company offers crystal and organic sugar; hydrated anhydrous industrial and organic ethanol; sanitizing products; and yeast. It also produces clean and renewable energy from cane bagasse and straw. In addition the company engages in industrial automation 4G project agro-industrial control tower and research and development activiries. Jalles Machado S/A was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Goianésia Brazil.

Name: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries markets and distributes petroleum products primarily in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers one-stop-shop service stations that provides on- the-go shopping food and beverages; commercial fuels; fuel cards and lubricants; and digital transformation solutions. It also provides marine fuel and solutions advertisement and property rental services. In addition the company operates retail convenience store car care centers and coffee franchise. Further It markets and distributes petroleum products and bunker petroleum products. The company was formerly known as BP Oman SAOG and changed its name to Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG in October 2003. Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Ofis Yem Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. engages in the manufacturing wholesale or retail purchase import export and sale of processed or unprocessed feeds in Turkey. It produces vitamin supplements for live animals; engages in cattle breeding; and offers ovine calf fattening dairy and poultry feeds. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Tabuk Cement Company
Description: Tabuk Cement Company manufactures and sells cement in Saudi Arabia. It offers ordinary Portland blended hydraulic pozzolana agglomerated and sulphate resisting cement products. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Tabuk Saudi Arabia.

Name: Mpact Limited
Description: Mpact Limited engages in the paper and plastic packaging and recycling business in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Paper and Plastics segments. The company offers recycled-based packaging and industrial paper such as containerboard and carton board and other materials; corrugated packaging products; bags; and sacks as well as plastic packaging solutions. It serves packaging converters fruit producers FMCG companies and quick restaurant sectors as well as food beverage personal care home care pharmaceutical agricultural and retail markets. The company is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
Description: Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter Ethical Products and Consumer Healthcare Product. It offers drugs infusions and injectables. The company also provides products for anti infective and anti malaria central nervous system and cough and cold gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions. Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)
Description: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries engages in producing marketing selling and storing pharmaceutical reagents for human and veterinary use. It is also involved in producing marketing selling and storing diagnostic reagents for individuals laboratories and hospitals; importing pharmaceutical reagents and raw materials; producing pharmaceutical reagents for human veterinary and diagnostic use; and producing food supplements for human use. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Indeks Bilgisayar Sistemleri Mühendislik Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi distributes IT products in Turkey. The company’s products portfolio includes computers/tablets smartphones printers consumer electronics software peripherals wearable technologies data storage and smart home products OEM products and accessories. It also purchases and sells spare parts and home electronics as well as provides logistics and leasing; and elevator maintenance and rental services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A.
Description: Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. engages in the sale of vehicles and spare parts in Tunisia. It is also involved in the manufacture of electronic equipment comprising filters for the automotive and real estate development industries. The company was formerly known as Renault Tunisie. Automobile Réseau Tunisien et Services S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Tunis Tunisia.

Name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. manufactures and distributes dairy products in Egypt. The company engages in the packing and pasteurization of liquid dairies cream and natural butter as well as white dry and cooked cheese; and yogurt ice creams biscuits and natural fruit juices. It is also involved in the production sale of milk and livestock production. The company also exports production requirements and products. Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi
Description: Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi manages and processes fruits and vegetables in Turkey. The company offers concentrate puree concentrate puree deionized concentrate frozen IQF natural peel oils natural fruit FTNF direct pressed fruit juices dried seeds consumer products and fresh fruits products. It offers its products under Fruit Drops Get One and Absolutely brand names. The company exports its products. Göknur Gida Maddeleri Enerji Imalat Ithalat Ihracat Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Ankara Turkey.

Name: Unilever Ghana PLC
Description: Unilever Ghana PLC manufactures and markets sells fast-moving consumer goods in Ghana. It operates through the Nutrition Home Care and Beauty & Personal Care segments. The company provides laundry and household care products; and skin cleansing skin care oral and deodorant products. It is also involved in investment management; real estate development; and manufacturing importing and exporting goods wares and merchandise. The company is headquartered in Tema Ghana. Unilever Ghana PLC is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings Limited.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through the Car Rental and Leasing segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short-term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name; replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies; and other complementary products including the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. Its Leasing Business segment offers leasing services of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities; complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services; and service and maintenance plans. In addition the company sells its cars from its rental and leasing businesses to retail customers and wholesalers through dealerships wholesale outlets online channels and independent wholesalers. It also engages in the advertisement of its retail vehicles through Avis Car Sales and other third-party websites as well as the sale of wholesale stock through the Avis Auction online auction trading platform and bulk deal offerings directly to the market. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Cashbuild Limited
Description: Cashbuild Limited engages in the retailing of building materials and associated products in South Africa Botswana Eswatini Lesotho Namibia Zambia and Malawi. It operates through Cashbuild P&L Hardware Cashbuild Common Monetary Operations and Cashbuild Non-Common Monetary Operations segments. The company offers builder hand and garden tools; safety equipment and workwear tanks field toilets drain covers and wheel barrows; and aggregates plastic sheeting and steel products. It also provides brickwork; concrete; cement; electrical and bathroom and kitchen products; doors putty and windows; roofing and ceiling products; tools and hardware; inverters petrol generators lighting and gas solutions; soft drinks and snacks; and outdoor and decorative products. It serves contractors homebuilders and improvers farmers traders and other customers. The company operates through the Cashbuild model and P&L Hardware stores. Cashbuild Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: BAAN Holding Group Company
Description: BAAN Holding Group Company for Tourism and Development Company provides hospitality and entertainment services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. It operates through Hotel Entertainment and Other segments. The company operates hotels tourism health resort cafes and restaurants as well as furnished apartments entertainment and recreation centers tourist resorts commercial malls fun cities parks and gardens and related facilities. It also operates and manages electrical games hall children amusement games hall and electronic games as well as establishes and operates sports facilities projects. The company was formerly known as Abdulmohsen Al-Hokair Group and changed its name to BAAN Holding Group Company in November 2024. BAAN Holding Group Company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Riyadh Saudi Arabia.

Name: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries provides transportation and logistics services in Turkey and internationally. The company offers transportation services including international road transport international air freight national and international rail freight international sea freight intermodal transport domestic full track load transportation domestic distribution furniture distribution and project cargo transportation services; and storage services such as conventional dealer-shared e-commerce and furniture warehouses. It also provides e-services comprising e-export e-commerce logistics Horoz wallet and Alibaba membership; other services consisting of furniture assembly and SSH project management and consulting and customs and insurance services; and partial load distribution and third-party logistics services. Horoz Lojistik Kargo Hizmetleri ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Disway S.A.
Description: Disway S.A. distributes IT and telecom equipment products in Morocco and internationally. The company offers laptops desktop PC and all in one computers; printers scanners point of sale terminals tracers copiers faxes and consumables; tablets smartphones connected objects headphones and earphones; multimedia products; and accessories. It also provides various solutions including serves networks data centers storages backups software and video surveillance. In addition it provides solar products such as solar panels pumping and accessories; on and off grid solutions; and protective equipment. Further the company offers logistics services; manages stocks; processes orders; and engages in packing and co-packing drop shipping assembly inventory and reporting services. It serves gaming industry. It sells its products under HP ASUS and LENOVO brands. Disway S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. produces and supplies French fries in Turkey. It provides potato wedges spicy coated potato wedges crinkle potato spicy coated crinkle potato coated cage fries and spicy coated cage fries. The company also offers frozen cheese stick and onion rings. It supplies its products to quick service restaurants. The company also exports its products to the United Arab Emirates China Iraq the United Kingdom and Uzbekistan. Atakey Patates Gida Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Saudi Marketing Company
Description: Saudi Marketing Company engages in the retail trading and importing business in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through three segments: Retail Household and Entertainment Service. The company is involved in wholesale and retail of food household utensils toys fabrics and clothing and stationery products. It also provides marketing services; operates and manages bakeries restaurants and cafes; and establishes operates and maintains entertainment centers. The company operates under the Farm Superstores name. Saudi Marketing Company was founded in 1978 and is based in Dammam Saudi Arabia.

Name: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Yatas Yatak ve Yorgan Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells mattress modular furniture duvet sofa home textile and furniture. The company offers beds and mattresses protector and sleeping pad; pillow; home textile products that include bedding sets bedspreads pike blanket sheets and pillowcases bathroom textiles cushions sofa throw wedding gift set and sleep set. It also offers base and headboard sets; home and sitting room products such as TV blanket slipper pet bed; and baby shower set. It sells its products through stores and online. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi
Description: Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi provides electricity contracting services in Turkey. The company offers electrical contracting services for weak current systems LV electrical contract works MV electrical contract works; and construction services. It also generates renewable energy from the sun wind rain tides waves and geothermal heat as well as constructs urban transformation projects. The company was formerly known as ORGE Enerji Sistemleri Insaat Metal Ticaret ve Taahhüt A.S. and changed its name to Orge Enerji Elektrik Taahhüt Anonim Sirketi in June 2010. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Abra Information Technologies Ltd.
Description: Abra Information Technologies Ltd. provides information technology solutions in Israel. The company provides managed research and development services; customer relationship management system solutions such as system specification cross-organizational implantation process automation instruction and training and ongoing support solutions; UX and UI designing studio; enterprise resource planning system solutions including project management training and instruction data migration and support and service center as well as consultancy application and implementation solutions; business intelligence solution; strategy realization such as project management and agile transformation solutions as well as implementing PPM Jira and Atlassian tools; cloud solutions; e-commerce and marketing automation comprising development of e-commerce websites and systems technological specifications and UI/UX and IoT direct sales solutions; cyber consulting solutions including information and cyber security management technological consultancy and test and supply chain security solutions; and operates training center as well as provides courses. It serves health security fintech hi-tech government and commerce and retail industries. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Ra'annana Israel.

Name: City Cars S.A.
Description: City Cars S.A. distributes transport vehicles and spare parts under the brand of Kia in Tunisia. The company is involved in storing washing servicing and marketing of spare part accessories and transport vehicle. It also engages in purchases and sales of used vehicles and accessories. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in La Goulette Tunisia.

Name: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the production and marketing of manganese minerals and ferroalloys in Mexico and internationally. It is also involved in the electricity generation and mining of precious metals. The company offers ferroalloy and manganese products including high medium and low carbon ferromanganese; silicomanganese; nitrided medium carbon ferromanganese; manganese nodules and carbonates; and other specialty ferroalloys as well as manganese derivatives such as battery-grade natural manganese dioxide ceramic-grade natural manganese dioxide and manganous oxide products. In addition the company generates electricity through hydroelectric plant; and produces electrolytic manganese dioxides. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in San Pedro Garza García Mexico. Compañía Minera Autlán S.A.B. de C.V. operates as a subsidiary of Autlán Holding SAPI de CV.

Name: AECI Mining Explosives PLC
Description: AECI Mining Explosives PLC manufactures and supplies mining explosives and mining chemicals in Africa Europe Southeast Asia North America South America and Australia. It operates in four segments: AECI Mining AECI Chemicals AECI Managed Businesses and AECI Property Services and Corporate. The AECI Mining segment provides a mine-to-mineral solution for the international mining sector including commercial explosives initiating systems blasting services and surfactants for explosives manufacturers Its AECI Chemicals segment supplies traded industrial and specialty chemicals as well as water treatment chemicals technology equipment and plant and crop protection products and plant nutrients. The AECI Managed Businesses segment engages in agriculture industrial manufacturing road infrastructure food and beverage public water and animal feed businesses as well as the textile sector. Its AECI Property Services and Corporate segment is involved in property leasing and management in the office industrial and retail sectors. It serves the mining sector water treatment market plant and animal health industry food and beverage and the manufacturing and general industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as AEL Zambia Plc and changed its name to AECI Mining Explosives PLC in August 2021. AECI Mining Explosives PLC was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V.
Description: Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. engages in the design urbanization construction promotion and sale of homes in Mexico. The company develops social interest middle-class middle-residential and residential housing. Corpovael S.A.B. de C.V. was founded in 2001 and is based in Cancun Mexico.

Name: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S.
Description: Alkim Alkali Kimya A.S. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of paper products in Turkey. The company offers first pulp paper coated and photocopy paper. It also provides sodium sulphate potassium sulphate salt and magnesium chloride liquid. In addition it offers insurance brokerage services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Fan Milk PLC
Description: Fan Milk PLC produces manufactures and distributes recombined milk and other dairy products in Ghana Nigeria Côte d'Ivoire Togo and Burkina Faso. It offers frozen dairy juice dairy drinkable and spoonable and ice cream products under the FanVanille FanYogo SuperYogo FanXtra FanChoco FanDango FanJoy FanMaxx yogo FanIce VIKINGStar Goslo and Yaourt brand names. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Accra Ghana. Fan Milk PLC is a subsidiary of Fan Milk International A/S.

Name: Positivo Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Positivo Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures sells and distributes hardware software and information technology (IT) solutions in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through Consumer Public Institutions and Corporate segments. It offers computers smartphones tablets accessories smart home and environment devices office products electronic security devices servers mobile payment terminals payment machines and IT infrastructure products; education technology solutions including self-service kiosks data collection devices for demographic surveys and electronic voting machines; and medical laboratory and communication equipment. The company also engages in the rental of IT and mobility (hardware as a service) equipment; provision of IT technical support and managed IT services; sale of pedagogic application systems and school administration products; technical-pedagogical planning and support; and representation sale implementation training support and technical assistance for equipment as well as for technical technological and scientific teaching systems. It serves end consumers residential condominiums businesses schools and public institutions. The company was formerly known as Positivo Informática S.A. and changed its name to Positivo Tecnologia S.A. in April 2017. Positivo Tecnologia S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Curitiba Brazil.

Name: Cadbury Nigeria Plc
Description: Cadbury Nigeria Plc engages in manufacturing and selling branded fast moving consumer goods in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Refreshment Beverages Confectionery and Intermediate Cocoa Products. The Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and sells Cadbury Bournvita and Cadbury 3-in-1 Hot Chocolate. The Confectionary segment manufactures and sells Tom Tom Candy Caramel Buttermint Candy Coffee and Clorets gum products. The Intermediate Cocoa Products segment manufactures and sells cocoa powder cocoa butter cocoa liquor and cocoa cake. It offers its products through a network of distributors key accounts and institutional customers as well as chain of wholesalers and retailers. It exports its products to various countries in Africa and Europe. Cadbury Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Cadbury Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Cadbury Schweppes Overseas Limited.

Name: Vittia S.A.
Description: Vittia S.A. manufacturing and sale of compost fertilizers biological pesticides and other chemical products in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Soil fertilizers; Foliar Fertilizers Industrial Products and Others; and Biological and Natural Solutions segments. The company offers biofertilizers and functional concentrated suspension inoculants macro and micro premium products. It also provides biological and natural crop protection including fungicide and bactericide insecticide microbiological agent multi-site fungicide and nematicide and soil fungicide; nutrition; and adjuvant products used in apple and pear banana beans brassicas citrus coffee corn cotton grapevine mango melon onion pasture peanut potato rice sesame sorghum soybean strawberry sugarcane tomato and wheat crops. The company was formerly known as Vittia Fertilizantes e Biológicos S.A. and changed its name to Vittia S.A. in May 2023. Vittia S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in São Joaquim da Barra Brazil.

Name: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
Description: Aztek Teknoloji Urunleri Ticaret Anonim Sirketi together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of technology and consumer electronics in Turkey and Russia. The company offers cables adapters bags cases and similar accessory products for audio and video equipment. It also provides maintenance and repair services. The company sells its products under the Apple Beats by Dr. Dre JBL Harman Kardon Thule Case Logic Marshall Urbanears and Hama brands names through stores and online. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Takween Advanced Industries
Description: Takween Advanced Industries produces and sells plastic packaging products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the Arab Republic of Egypt and internationally. The company offers polyethylene terephthalate (PET) Preforms for bottle manufacturing in the food beverage and dairy industries; PET and HDPE bottles for dairy beverages food and personal care applications; closures; and thermoformed and In-Mold Labeling (IML) packaging solutions. It also provides shrink films for food beverage and industrial applications; PS and PP sheet rolls; plastic crates and pallets; and flexible packaging solutions include custom plastic bags for food retail and industrial applications; and specialized industrial plastic including drums Jerry cans form-fill & seal (FFS) film HDPE insulation film and greenhouse plastic rolls. In addition the company provides disposable polystyrene cups lids and other plastic related products; and non-woven fabric products. Further it engages manufacture wholesale and retail trading of plastic containers and polyethylene cups rolls and bags; and management and operation of industrial centers. Additionally the company owns land; establishes industrial institutes and provides and coordinates training courses related to the development of plastic products; and establishes manages operates and maintains various industrial projects as well as engages in the import and export wholesale and retail of plastic products. The company was formerly known as Al-Othman Plastic Products. Takween Advanced Industries was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Al Khobar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Name: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. through its subsidiaries operates in the IT and communication technology; engineering procurement and construction (EPC); consultancy; oil and gas; trading; logistics; and MEP sectors. The company offers cyber security unified communication and collaboration software defined networking next generation network structured cabling low voltage cable installation fiber-optic network security wireless and mobility TETRA and AVLS solutions; a range of security and safety services for businesses governments and residences; and audio and visual solutions as well as operates as an EPC contractor for various industries including oil and gas power water and infrastructure. It also provides centralized alarm monitoring station intrusion and burglary alarm system virtual guarding and CCTV integration central control designing maintenance technical support and alarm monitoring services as well as intrusion alarm for armoured vehicles and development/integration of centralized software. In addition the company offers consultancy and human resource management services; a range of services for communications-related areas such as collaboration data centers cloud solutions information management and fully-managed managed services; and undertakes steel structural piping and related support structural and pre engineered building works as well as miscellaneous works comprising fire escape ladders fencing catwalk systems storage space gratings and chequered plates emergency stairs and balustrades gates hand rails etc. Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2018 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company provides private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical auditing services medical billing processing call center licensing of hospital network and claims management systems and other outsourced support services. In addition the company provides mass insurance brokerage through retail channels such as life insurance capitalization home insurance extended warranty financial protection insurance and others. Further the company identifies the target market defines the marketing strategy and distribution model and offers membership plans to potential clients through its own distribution channel or a network of accredited insurance brokers. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. It was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG
Description: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG manufactures and sells glazed ceramic tiles in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers floor outdoor floor wall and elevated wall tiles as well as decorative panels under the Al Shams brand name. It exports its products to approximately 20 countries in the Middle East and Africa. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Méliuz S.A.
Description: Méliuz S.A. together with its subsidiaries operate a virtual portal for the placement and dissemination of brands products services and other advertising and publicity materials. It operates through B2C (BusinesstoCustomers)National; and Other segments. The company offers leasing of virtual advertising space for the insertion of texts drawings and other materials as well as rental of space. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Unité de Fabrication des Médicaments S.A
Description: Unité de Fabrication des Médicaments S.A. develops manufactures markets and sells generic and fashioned medicines in Tunisia and internationally. The company offers ophthalmic ENT inhalation and infusion solutions injectable fluids and penicillin and cephalosporin powders for various therapeutic areas under the UNIMED brand name. It exports its products to Africa Asia and Europe. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Sousse Tunisia.

Name: Conoil Plc
Description: Conoil Plc markets refined petroleum products and manufactures and markets lubricants household and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Nigeria. The company operates through three segments: White Products Lubricants and Liquefied Petroleum Gas. Its White Products segment sells premium motor spirit aviation turbine kerosene dual-purpose kerosene low-pour fuel oil and automotive gasoline/grease oil. The Lubricants segment offers transport and industrial lubricants greases process oil and bitumen. Its LPG segment is involved in the trading of bulk and packed LPG cylinders and valves. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc and changed its name to Conoil Plc in January 2003. Conoil Plc was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Conoil Plc is a subsidiary of Conpetro Limited.

Name: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S.
Description: Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. produces and sells radial tires for passenger cars vans minibuses trucks and buses under the Goodyear Fulda Sava Debica and Kelly brands worldwide. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Maslak Türkiye. Goodyear Lastikleri T.A.S. operates as a subsidiary of Goodyear S.A.

Name: Gemfields Group Limited
Description: Gemfields Group Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a mining company. It operates through Kagem Mining Limited Montepuez Ruby Mining Limitada Development Assets Fabergé Corporate and Other segments. The company explores for emerald beryl ruby corundum gold and allied minerals in Zambia Mozambique Ethiopia and Madagascar. It also engages in the sale of cut and polished gemstones and jewellery; and provision of marketing and technical and administrative services. The company was formerly known as Pallinghurst Resources Limited and changed its name to Gemfields Group Limited in June 2018. Gemfields Group Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in London the United Kingdom.

Name: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S.
Description: Büyük Sefler Gida Turizm Tekstil Danismanlik Organizasyon Egitim Sanayi Ve Ticaret A.S. together with its subsidiaries operates a chain of restaurants in Turkey and internationally. The company operates restaurants under the BigChefs Numnum Numnum Streetfood Buselik and Akademi BigChefs brands. It also franchises its restaurants. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Istanbul Turkey.

Name: Société Nouvelle Maison de la Ville de Tunis
Description: Société Nouvelle Maison de la Ville de Tunis together with its subsidiaries engages in the multi-department retailing of various goods and products in Tunisia. It is also involved in the refrigeration freezing processing and packaging of meat agricultural and fishing products as well as offers real estate promotion services. The company was founded in 1933 and is based in Mégrine Tunisia.

Name: CM Hospitalar S/A
Description: CM Hospitalar S/A engages in the distribution of hospital materials medicines and nutrition products in Brazil.
